review_kind: Finite FIRST SVG fidelity review supplement for the historical source274277 batch; not a production worker
SVG_reason: Two SVGs preserve the required reference ink. fig-230 retains six sample marks but its sixth mark has no demonstrable hollow center. The approved RAW reference also lacks that hollow center, so this is an unresolved six-hollow-sample requirement, not a confirmed SVG-specific loss.

scope.new_visual_decisions: Only PASS/HOLD for the three named source-faithful SVGs, using the three named already-approved RAW PNGs as references.
scope.SOURCE_statement: The task states that original SOURCE text has already passed FIRST plus affected review. No text or page-grid source review is repeated. Historical SOURCE findings in d1283 are not reopened or re-adjudicated.
scope.RAWPNG_statement: The three PASS entries in d1283 RAWPNG_reviews are existing facts. Each exact hash-matching RAW was opened only as a comparison reference for the missing FIRST SVG review. No new RAW approval, RAW HOLD, or RAW status change is issued.
scope.scope_of_SVG_PASS: A source-faithful SVG ink-preservation decision for the exact SVG and archived preview hashes only. Not modern-figure quality-gate approval, native-runtime evidence, source promotion, assembly, publication, or complete-card approval.

page275_recovery_binding.reason: Optional text-only recovery binding check was not needed to decide this three-SVG batch. No page275 text approval or reconstructed-MD hash-equivalence claim is made.

RAWPNG_FIRST.fig230_existing_prose_fact: The historical RAWPNG review describes six open-circle samples. That review is preserved unchanged; this supplement cannot attest six hollow centers in the specified current SVG preview.

d1309_archived_manifest.path_relocation: Historical /00b1/ paths are provenance only. This supplement binds the explicitly listed current absolute paths by matching bytes, without replaying old commands.

method.visual_comparison: One sequential RAW-reference/SVG-preview pair per figure. Only the six authorized existing PNG files were visually loaded, each exactly once, at their supplied native dimensions. No new rendering, cropping, resizing, compositing, or image-bearing history.
method.svg_preview_binding: Current RAW, SVG and archived preview hashes were compared with the three figures entries in the hash-bound d1309 report. Preview pixels were inspected rather than assuming path geometry alone establishes fidelity.
method.supplemental_pixel_analysis: Read-only binary PNG decoding of the already-viewed fig-230 RAW and SVG-preview files using Python standard-library struct/zlib. No image payload was emitted, no PNG was written, and no image was visually reopened. Four-connected above-threshold white components were flood-filled in six bounded sample regions; components touching a region edge were excluded. Thresholds 127 and 200 were checked after compositing alpha onto white.
method.supplemental_svg_text_analysis: Read the existing fig-230 SVG as text only. Its evenodd path contains interior subpaths near the first five sample centers, but no corresponding sixth-center hole subpath. This is supporting evidence, not a replacement for the preview comparison.
method.tool_note: An initial read-only Pillow import probe returned ModuleNotFoundError. No dependency was installed; the binary pixel check used the standard library instead.

observations.face: Hair outline and parting, forehead/temple edges, eyebrows and eyes, ear outline, nose, moustache, mouth, cheeks, jaw and chin remain identifiable in the same source arrangement. No necessary facial contour is missing.
observations.bust: Neck/shirt collar, dark tie, jacket/lapels, shoulder contours and the full visible bottom bust boundary are retained.
observations.boundaries: White margin remains around the portrait; no face or bust edge is clipped and no neighboring prose or caption is introduced.
observations.trace_cleanup: Smoothing and removal of isolated scan specks do not remove necessary portrait ink.
observations.identity: Existing source-bound identity is reused from the old RAW review, not newly inferred from the face. The synthetic tbl-p0274-01 name is not interpreted as a printed table.

observations.labels: The sensitive-element Chinese label, l, Delta-l, red-light Chinese label and violet-light Chinese label all retain their necessary glyph strokes and placements.
observations.arrows: Both total-length arrowheads, both inward narrow-width arrowheads, the sensitive-element leader arrow, and both color-label leaders with their terminal marks remain.
observations.geometry: Long spectrum rectangle, solid narrow sensitive strip, lower projection edges, and both total-length endpoint extensions are retained.
observations.boundaries: Top label, left red label, lower Delta-l and projection strokes, right violet label, and right rectangle edge remain inside the supplied frame. No caption, prose or new numbers are added.

observations.sample_marks: All six source sample-mark positions remain, in left-to-right order near x=201,254,306,362,413,465. The first five have small retained white interiors; the sixth is a solid bump joined to the curve and its vertical guide in the current preview.
observations.curve: Single descending and flattening thick curve and its two original endpoint regions remain; no additional data curve or numeric axis values appear.
observations.labels_and_arrows: Stacked Delta-E/Delta-t fraction with its bar, nu, endpoint nu with red/violet subscripts, upward y-arrowhead and rightward x-arrowhead are retained.
observations.boundaries: Below-x y-axis extension, both endpoint delimiters, all five short ticks, labels and arrowheads remain within the frame. No caption or neighboring prose is introduced.

findings.finding: The sixth/rightmost sampled marker, immediately left of the right solid endpoint delimiter, has no enclosed white center in the SVG preview. Thus the requested six hollow sample points cannot be certified: five hollow centers and one filled sample mark are demonstrable.
findings.reference_comparison: The already-approved, byte-identical RAW has no enclosed white center at that same sixth sample either. The SVG retains the sixth sample's visible ink bump and guide. Do not describe this as an observed SVG conversion erasure, do not silently revise the old RAW PASS, and do not equate six retained marks with six demonstrated hollow points.
findings.decision_boundary: HOLD is limited to this FIRST SVG's requested six-hollow-center assertion. No SOURCE or RAW decision is reissued; no candidate repair or new source-image inspection is performed.
findings.other_required_strokes: Six dashed guides, five intermediate short ticks, two solid endpoint delimiters, the curve, axis labels, endpoint subscripts, axis arrowheads and figure boundaries are retained.

pixel_check.coordinate_system: Zero-based native pixels; region maxima exclusive
pixel_check.limitations: Native-preview topology only. This check does not reconstruct a missing source hole, infer intent from the subject matter, inspect a page grid, or approve SVG legibility at untested display widths.

stop: Finite batch complete. Return text and this report absolute path with SHA-256, then stop. No follow-on production work is authorized.
